nira: Postmortem follow-up: let's lock owners for each action and add Jira links. Reply with Owner | short AC | ETA | Jira. Keep it compact.

gopal: I'll own the KV TTL fix + unit tests. AC: TTL edge case covered, tests + CI green. ETA: 2026-04-10. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-9901

morgan: I'll write the canary rollout plan and update the postmortem doc (RACI). AC: 24h canary + rollback thresholds recorded. ETA: 2026-04-12. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-9903

oncall-bot: Reminder: RDW-9901 (gopal) due in 3 days.

gopal: I can create RDW-9904 for "hotfix + runbook" and link it. ETA: 2026-04-09.

frank: I'll add a tiny perf smoke into the canary job and attach results to RDW-9902.

morgan: Updated postmortem Owners table and linked tickets; setting due dates ISO. Final review in planning.

nira: AC checklist to include in PRs: TTL fix, unit tests, perf snapshot, canary config + rollback, postmortem linked.

oncall-bot: Note: RDW-9904 (gopal) marked high priority by nira.

morgan: I'll paste this thread into the postmortem actions and close after QA verifies ACs. Escalate in #postmortems if any slips. :wave:
